_comment: Features that predate the FSM (D-sw-factory-18, D-sw-factory-19).
The six rungs rest on four sources, and they are not equally trustworthy on
old work. recall/grounding/deciding come from journal rows that had to be
written BEFORE the work, so they cannot be satisfied after the fact. building
comes from checkboxes, and those are under-reported - wow-enforcement claimed
0 of 5 steps done while all 5 deliverables had shipped.
So the tool claims NOTHING about the features listed here. It does not mark
their rungs satisfied - that would assert they passed a bar they never faced,
and would forge the evidence the FSM exists to demand. It reports them as
untracked: no phase, no ladder, no advice.
To opt one back in, delete its line. From that moment it is measured in full.
